config.js_code: function generateUUID() { return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) { const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0; const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8); return v.toString(16); }); } async function makeRequestId() { var uuid = generateUUID(); var date = new Date(); var current_time = Math.round(date.getTime() / 1000); var requestId = { ts: current_time, appid: 'com.postman.request', uuid: uuid }; var requestIdStr = JSON.stringify(requestId); let url = 'https://pilot-root.1kosmos.net/walletapi/ecdsa_helper/encrypt'; let otherPartyPublicKey = '<PUBLIC_KEY>'; let privateKey = '<PRIVATE_KEY>'; let respData = null; await fetch (url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ 'data': requestIdStr, 'publicKey': otherPartyPublicKey, 'privateKey': privateKey }) }) .then((response) => response.text()).then((result) => {respData = result}).catch((error) => {throw new Error(error)}); return respData; } let requestId = await makeRequestId(); return {requestId};

async function makePayload() { let payload = { account: { authModuleId: '69f53cf5115a75ae0e838ac5', communityId: '69f5290924326a72be91cb09', tenantId: '6843d79e3b79c3268776cc63', uid: params.nodes.check_onboarding_user.respData.data.uid, username: params.nodes.check_onboarding_user.respData.data.username }, uid: params.nodes.check_onboarding_user.respData.data.uid, authModuleId: '69f53cf5115a75ae0e838ac5', username: params.nodes.check_onboarding_user.respData.data.username }; var dataStr = JSON.stringify(payload); let url = 'https://pilot-root.1kosmos.net/walletapi/ecdsa_helper/encrypt'; let otherPartyPublicKey = '<PUBLIC_KEY>'; let privateKey = '<PRIVATE_KEY>'; let respData = null; await fetch (url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ 'data': dataStr, 'publicKey': otherPartyPublicKey, 'privateKey': privateKey }) }) .then((response) => response.text()).then((result) => {respData = result}).catch((error) => {throw new Error(error)}); return respData; } let payload = await makePayload(); return {payload};

async function createACRCode(requestIdEnc, payloadEnc) { let rootApi = 'https://sandbox.1kosmos.net'; let communityName = '<COMMUNITY_NAME>'; let url = rootApi + '/api/r2/acr/community/' + communityName + '/code'; let respData = null; await fetch (url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'X-TenantTag': '<TENANT_TAG>', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'publickey': '<KEY_ID>', 'licensekey': 'b18d6489-05fb-4d92-9254-56943d041ea3', 'requestid': requestIdEnc }, body: JSON.stringify({ 'data': payloadEnc }) }) .then((response) => response.json()).then((result) => {respData = result}).catch((error) => {throw new Error(error)}); return respData; } let acrResp = await createACRCode(params.nodes.make_request_id_onboarding.requestId, params.nodes.make_acr_payload_onboarding.payload); return {acrResp};
